# América Special Tours — US English

> Individually planned journeys with personal advice from your Travel Atelier Advisor.
> This static English mirror contains 79 public pages, including 72 published trip ideas.

## Planning and legal context
Trip ideas are inspiration, not binding package travel offers. Services, contracting
parties, and contractual relationships are disclosed in the individual proposal.
Routes, prices, services, and availability must be confirmed for your dates.
Published German-speaking guiding is not a promise of English-speaking guiding.
Prices remain in euros; no currency conversion has been applied.
Legal and privacy placeholders must be completed and reviewed before launch.
